raw_response:
I was lucky to receive fertilizer coupons from FISP this season, so I will put NPK and some urea on this maize field because it feeds my family. I also have a small pile of goat manure that I will work into the soil at planting, and I will use the hybrid seed they gave us at the depot since it grows better than our local maize. I cannot buy pesticides or pay for irrigation, so I will weed by hand with my children when the rains come. We will work this plot from planting through harvest, but I have no money to hire ganyu workers.
